fusions.name: Sieve the Shallows
fusions.desc: Combs the tines through every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 3 damage, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Upended Reach
fusions.desc: Tips forward and strikes a target up to 6 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Preened Slick
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Nothing Wasted
fusions.desc: When you regain health, you also regain 5 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
